text:
Maya: Quick poll — who’s decking their desk with lights this week? I’m thinking a tiny competition (bribing judges with brownies) :grin:
Aaron: Count me in. Full icicle setup on the monitor stand. Pic incoming. :christmas_tree:
Jess: Can we make it 'most creative lights with no fire hazard'? :fire_extinguisher:
Priya: uploaded an image: <img_2026-12-03_15-02.jpg> — delicate paper snowflakes + warm LEDs. cozy. :snowflake:
Sam: I vote Priya already. Also suggest emoji voting: :heart: = 1 vote, :star: = 2 votes, :tada: = 3 votes
Maya: Love it. Reactions will be the official vote. I’ll tally Friday morning. Prize = $25 cafe voucher + eternal bragging rights :trophy:
Leo: Remote folks joining — I’ve got a string of LEDs on my houseplant (and my cat tolerated it for 5 minutes) :cat_with_rolling_eyes: — posting from home!
Jess: @Leo yes remote totally welcome. Post pics here or drop in the #general during lunch for a live stroll-through.
HolidayBot: Facilities reminder — holiday lights must be unplugged by 7pm on Friday per safety policy. Please follow the cord routing guidelines. :bulb:
Aaron: Noted. Also I can bring a dozen brownies on Friday morning. Anyone allergic?
Priya: I’ll take two, allergy-free please (gluten free is ideal). :raised_hands:
Sam: Reaction poll so far: :heart: (Priya), :star: (Aaron), :thumbsup: (Jess), :tada: (Leo) — keep ’em coming
Maya: Final call — post your pics by 5pm tomorrow. Thank you for the festive vibes everyone! :sparkles:
